nodes.title: Dry run of the four pilots on integration 85 (16 lessons, no model): every gated predicate 0, the picture-drawn check included; the steady lessons end 4, 5, 4, 4 turns on a comprehension check-in (director29 live: 6, 6, 5, 6)

md.measurements: - `ms-r8-d30-dry` (2026-11-18): the dry matrix (no model, rule-based child) over the four pilots × steady, stuck, offtopic, steering on integration 85 (Brain 045, Learning 018, main's script fixes): 16 lessons, 644 teacher turns. `check-run.mjs` exit 0, every gated predicate 0, including the ones written from director29's rows: `pictureDrawn` (a picture turn's drawn panel is the board the plan named; it reads 4 on director29's steering rows and on the code before the fix), `pageStart` from one function, `stepToldEarly`, `keyEarly` with the two new rungs, `helpSpentCold`, `reaskFigure`. Pending: `repeatedAuthored` 46 (a question said at the end of two turns running: the card after help or a hint, an asked step after its easier wording, the card after a picture; intended by the help rule), `replyCheckin` 1 (c4 offtopic: a reply into a bridge whose card is held back for a due park return), `parkCutByChildEnd` 1; `pointNoFit`, `workedNoFit`, `cardNoFit` 0. The adversarial probe lost 0 of 645 turns (the build agent's run). Turns over 75 words: 3 (offtopic-c6-ch06-t01 row 18: 79; steering-c5-ch02-t02 row 4: 78; stuck-c5-ch02-t02 row 4: 80), each led by a park line or the start line; none over 90. Turns ending on a comprehension check-in in the steady lessons (c4, c5-t01, c5-t02, c6): 4, 5, 4, 4 of 95, 97, 105, 103 rows (director29 live: 6, 6, 5, 6 of 99, 99, 103, 103). What remains after a right answer within a skill: the turn before an aside's return (ruled its own turn), the closing question's verdict before the wrap, and one c4 turn whose answer board and next point's board cannot be joined under the 120-op cap (52 + 52 + 44 ops). Limits: a dry run says what the walk plans, not how it sounds; director30 is the live reading.
